meta.title: Dialog compaction
meta.description: Compacts a long dialog into a short extract without a neural network: it reads the session log (the file where DSH records the conversation) and builds the sections “Task”, “What was done”, “Files”, “Commands”, “Open questions”, “Errors”. Everything runs locally — no network calls and no tokens spent. Open it under Settings → Plugins → “Dialog compaction” to choose a session and the summary size. The agent can also call it itself with the dialog_compact tool.
